title: 11.2 Areas of Circles and Sectors

icans: I can find the area of a circle and use it to find a radius.
I can find the area of a sector of a circle.
I can find the area of a shaded region made of circles and polygons.

vocab: the region bounded by two radii of the circle and their ______________ arc
the number of __________ units inside the circle: A = πr²

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem:
Find the area of each circle. Round to the nearest hundredth.
a.  radius 2.5 centimeters
b.  diameter 10 inches

notes: Area of a sector: area of sector APB = (m(arc AB) ÷ 360°) · _______________

blocks.stem: Find the area of the shaded sector and of the unshaded sector. Round to the nearest hundredth.

notes: Shaded regions: area of the shaded region = area of the whole figure _______________ the area of the part that is not shaded.

blocks.stem: A circle is inscribed in a square with sides of 10. Find the area of the shaded region. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A circle with a diameter of 8 is inscribed in a square with sides of 8. Find the area of the region inside the square but outside the circle. Round to the nearest hundredth.

tickets.stem: Find the area of a circle with a radius of 6 meters. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A circle has a radius of 10 inches. Find the area of a 90° sector. Round to the nearest hundredth.
